The DODCH Phenomenon: Dramatic Reflection & The Ethereal Liquid Glass Revolution

Prepare for a total visual transformation. The DODCH treatment isn't just a mask; it is a high-performance intervention designed to drape your hair in an iridescent, liquid-glass veil. We have engineered the ultimate sensory contradiction: a blinding, dramatic gloss that feels as light and airy as a Weightless Feather Cloud.

The Architecture of Infinite Shine

  • Dramatic Light Refraction: Our formula utilizes a sophisticated molecular smoothing system that resurfaces every individual strand. By filling in microscopic flaws, it creates a perfectly uniform plane that acts like a mirror, reflecting light with blinding, crystalline intensity.
  • The Liquid Glass Seal: We employ a precise pH-locking mechanism that induces immediate cuticle contraction. This creates a high-definition, "liquid" finish that mimics the fluid movement and hyper-glossy sheen of molten glass.
  • Anti-Dulling Mineral Defense: Dullness is the enemy of drama. Our specialized clarifying agents strip away the invisible environmental buildup and mineral deposits that sabotage your hair’s natural brilliance, revealing an unapologetic, raw luminosity.

Advanced Humectant ✦ Featured Active

Advanced Urea

A clinically proven keratolytic humectant that penetrates deep into the cortex — breaking hydrogen bonds in compacted, dehydrated fiber to restore suppleness, elasticity, and reverse brittleness at the molecular level.

DODCH Innovation

We developed a proprietary delivery system that makes urea more active, precisely targeted, molecularly stable, and safe for repeated use. Dosed at its real effective concentration, it releases gradually for zero compromise on hair integrity.

Unlike formulas that use token amounts, ours is measured to actually work — not just appear on the label.

Strengthening

Hydrolyzed Silk

Silk amino acids form a crystalline shield on every cuticle — filling surface gaps, flattening the fiber, and amplifying light for mirror-like shine.

Cuticle Sealing · Mirror Shine
Conditioning Matrix

Slip & Detangle

A synergistic blend of BTMS, Polyquaternium-39 (PQ-39), and Coco Natural Silicone. This trio creates a positively charged, weightless film that instantly melts away tangles and delivers unrivalled silky slip with zero buildup.

Weightless Slip · Instant Detangle
Deep Penetrant

Pro-Vitamin B5

Panthenol at effective concentration converts inside the cortex, binding moisture from within — thickening strands and preventing hygral fatigue without over-saturation.

Moisture Binding · Volume

pH Optimizer · AHA

Lactic Acid

A gentle AHA that acts as a precision pH adjuster — triggering immediate cuticle contraction for the glass-finish seal, and as an NMF humectant drawing lasting moisture into the cortex.

Founder's Note: For the most dramatic Liquid Glass reflection, apply a pea-sized amount to towel-dried hair. APPLICATION METRICS

The Ritual of Choice

DODCH Silk Mask adapts to your hair's immediate needs. Select your method of transformation.

Ritual I

The Rinse-Off Mask

For deep cuticle restoration, cortex repair, and intensive weekly treatment.

  1. 01 Apply generously to clean, damp hair, focusing mid-lengths to ends.
  2. 02 Massage evenly through strands, smoothing the cuticle downward.
  3. 03 Leave for 5–15 minutes, allowing active proteins to bond with fiber.
  4. 04 Rinse thoroughly with cool water to lock in active humectants and shine.
Ritual II

The Leave-In Therapy

For daily heat protection, frizz block, and the signature feather cloud bounce.

  1. 01 Apply a tiny pea-sized amount to clean, towel-dried hair.
  2. 02 Distribute evenly through damp lower half, detangling ends with fingers.
  3. 03 Do not rinse. Style normally to activate advanced thermal barriers.
  4. 04 Smooth a trace drop over dry styled hair to seal stray flyaways.

Experience the Silk Transformation

Hand-poured in limited batches to ensure the highest concentration of active silk proteins.
